_note: Cygnus A (3C 405), radio galaxy, at 1420 MHz. Total flux density 1556 Jy from Perley & Butler 2017, ApJS 230, 7 (arXiv:1609.05940), no secular change. Model: two Gaussian lobes on the jet axis (PA ~ -70 deg, north through east), compact hotspots at their outer ends ~62" (west, hotspot A) and ~67" (east, hotspot D) from the core, plus the flat-spectrum core (~0.6 Jy). The lobe/hotspot split (hotspots ~10 % of each lobe) and W:E ~ 52:48 are approximate; they give the correct total and a realistic fall-off of |V| with baseline length.
